particle_feature_inventory.finding: The exhaustive fptas feature inventory contains no particle-particle interaction feature.

statistical_assumptions.qualification: COMSOL documentation says different particle results are generally uncorrelated; this supports the registered finite-sample design but is not a proof of literal mathematical independence of a deterministic PRNG.
